# (model, element, property) rows GetElementProperties answers and the api-json export omits,
# with the clause the answer rests on. Tab-separated; TestElementPropertiesAgreeWithTheAPIJSONExport
# fails on a row missing here and on a row here the run no longer produces.
#
# Type::input on a requirement usage: the subject parameter it inherits from
# Requirements::RequirementCheck is an `in` parameter (its SubjectMembership is a
# ParameterMembership, SysML 2.1 Beta 2 8.3.21.11 SubjectMembership; KerML 1.1 Beta 2 8.3.3.1.10
# deriveTypeInput over directedFeature, inherited features included). The export's graph
# side reads the library feature's direction from semantics.Model.DeclaredDirection, which
# states none for a subject member, so it derives input without it.
examples/repl-behavioral-demo.sysml	SafetyReq	input	KerML 8.3.3.1.10 deriveTypeInput; SysML 8.3.21.11 SubjectMembership is a ParameterMembership
examples/repl-behavioral-demo.sysml	PerformanceReq	input	KerML 8.3.3.1.10 deriveTypeInput; SysML 8.3.21.11 SubjectMembership is a ParameterMembership
examples/repl-behavioral-demo.sysml	ViolatedReq	input	KerML 8.3.3.1.10 deriveTypeInput; SysML 8.3.21.11 SubjectMembership is a ParameterMembership
examples/repl-behavioral-demo.sysml	ComplexReq	input	KerML 8.3.3.1.10 deriveTypeInput; SysML 8.3.21.11 SubjectMembership is a ParameterMembership
#
# Step::parameter: the owned parameter-membership features of a calculation usage
# (KerML 1.1 Beta 2 8.3.5.3.2 deriveStepParameter). The export's completion table
# (apiJSONCompletedProperties) has no Step::parameter entry, so it never writes the key.
examples/repl-behavioral-demo.sysml	distance	parameter	KerML 8.3.5.3.2 deriveStepParameter
examples/repl-behavioral-demo.sysml	volume	parameter	KerML 8.3.5.3.2 deriveStepParameter
examples/repl-behavioral-demo.sysml	factorial	parameter	KerML 8.3.5.3.2 deriveStepParameter
examples/repl-behavioral-demo.sysml	celsiusToFahrenheit	parameter	KerML 8.3.5.3.2 deriveStepParameter
examples/repl-behavioral-demo.sysml	rectangleArea	parameter	KerML 8.3.5.3.2 deriveStepParameter
#
# ViewUsage::viewDefinition: the ViewDefinition typing the usage (SysML 2.1 Beta 2 8.3.26.6
# deriveViewUsageViewDefinition). Not in the export's completion table either.
examples/gridview-relationship-matrix.sysml	relationshipMatrix	viewDefinition	SysML 8.3.26.6 deriveViewUsageViewDefinition
